description: KdpD is the membrane sensor histidine kinase of the Staphylococcus aureus KdpD/KdpE two-component
  system. Its cytoplasmic domains couple environmental signals to the response regulator KdpE and expression
  of the Kdp potassium uptake system. A cytoplasmic universal stress protein domain binds cyclic di-AMP;
  this input suppresses salt-induced kdpFABC expression. The binding-to-kinase coupling mechanism has
  not been directly resolved by the receptor study.

document.description: KdpD is the membrane sensor histidine kinase of the Staphylococcus aureus KdpD/KdpE two-component system. Its cytoplasmic domains couple environmental signals to the response regulator KdpE and expression of the Kdp potassium uptake system. A cytoplasmic universal stress protein domain binds cyclic di-AMP; this input suppresses salt-induced kdpFABC expression. The binding-to-kinase coupling mechanism has not been directly resolved by the receptor study.

review.summary: KdpD is a phosphorelay sensor histidine kinase.
review.reason: The PAINT IBD at PTHR45569/PTN001976096 places sensor-kinase activity on the bacterial KdpD lineage using experimental E. coli P21865 evidence. The target retains HisKA/HATPase domains and curated membership in the KdpD/KdpE system. This supports inherited sensor activity; donor count is not used as a strength criterion. The required just paint-losses STAA8 kdpD check completed on 2026-11-04 using the PANTHER tree and current IBD GAF and found no IRD or IKR loss on the Q2FWH7 lineage.
